module AbortMainTopLevel

error NotFound

procedure service(id: Integer)
aborts NotFound when id = 0
is
    if id = 0 then
        abort NotFound
    end if
end service

procedure main()
aborts NotFound
is
    call service(0)
end main

end AbortMainTopLevel
